plan: Deliberate anti-Flying control six for a three-room Flying gym. Incineroar opens with Intimidate plus Fake Out and carries Knock Off (Dark) and Flare Blitz (Fire) as the two move types that can touch Wonder Guard Shedinja. Amoonguss Spore/Rage Powder buys turns against setup leads. Regieleki's Transistor Thunderbolt is the single hardest hit available into any Flying body and Electroweb is the answer to Tailwind. Zapdos adds bulky Electric plus special Heat Wave, the exact damage type Mega Skarmory is weak to. Weavile supplies fast Ice, Ice Shard priority under enemy Tailwind and a second Dark move for Shedinja. Mega Metagross resists Flying, Fairy, Rock and Ice and closes with Meteor Mash and Bullet Punch priority.
